tools.name: defiance_catalog_search
tools.description: Full-text search over the public catalog. Returns matching sequences with canonical links, release state, product status, from-price where the record states one, and stock availability. tools.name: defiance_sequence_lookup
tools.description: Returns the public record for one sequence: identity metadata, release state, availability, COA availability, and evidence links. Each size lists its priced offers (offerKey, priceCents, stockBand) and its defaultOfferKey; a size states no single price, and a size with no offer lists none. A record

tools.name: defiance_evidence_lookup
tools.description: Returns review-pending identity claims and literature sources for one sequence. Each claim carries a receipt naming the catalog store it was read from, the instant of that read and its derivation method. Claims are derived context, never measured lot values or efficacy statements. Source titles and

tools.name: defiance_policy_lookup
tools.description: Returns the platform’s research-use-only boundary, prohibited uses, and the lists of what public machine data is allowed versus blocked. No inputs.

tools.name: defiance_coa_education_lookup
tools.description: Explains what a Certificate of Analysis is and how lot verification works, and links the education course. Takes no lot identifiers and performs no verification: an agent cannot use it to discover which lots exist. Point a human at the signed verifier to check a real lot.

tools.name: defiance_platform_overview
tools.description: Returns the /platform page’s public copy at two reading levels, technical and plain language: how a lot is released against its analytical panel, what its certificate reports, where to check each statement, and how custody is recorded.
